title: 第8章 揭破秘密！
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
回去的路上，众人还在讨论王峰的事情，对此很是同情。

    只不过陆沉和玉凝两人都有些心不在焉。

    同样的，庄静白看向林天的目光也有些心虚，因为姜怀玉至少是受害者，而她……是迫害者！

    并且那三天的时间里，她也没开防护，万一……

    不可能！她是金丹期，陆沉是筑基七重，要是短短三天就能让自己肚子有动静，那修仙界的子嗣传承就是个笑话了！

    就这样，众人各怀心事的分开，然后各回各家。

    只是，陆沉刚到家中，就发现自己洞府中正站立着一道倩影。

    月色之下，那女子一身素白长裙，身姿窈窕，如月下仙子。青丝垂落腰际，仅用一根玉簪松松挽起，透着几分慵懒的美感。

    她似乎听到了动静，缓缓转过身来。

    陆沉看清那张脸的瞬间，呼吸都为之一滞。

    那是一张清冷出尘的面容，眉如远山含黛，目若秋水横波。肌肤胜雪，在月光下泛着淡淡莹光。

    只是那双美眸中，此刻却盛满了疲惫与哀伤，眼底隐隐泛着红血丝，显然是哭过许久。

    正是姜怀玉。

    她本就生得极美，是玄天宗公认的仙子人物。此刻带着几分憔悴，更显得我见犹怜，让人忍不住心生怜惜。

    陆沉心里咯噔一下，面上却强撑着镇定，拱手行礼：“怀玉师姐？这么晚了，你怎么……”

    “我等你很久了，陆沉。”姜怀玉的声音轻轻柔柔。

    陆沉心头一跳，硬着头皮请她入座：“师姐请坐，我给你倒茶。”

    他转身去拿茶壶，手却微微发抖。

    姜怀玉没有坐，只是站在原地，目光一直落在他身上。

    那目光太过专注，专注得让陆沉后背发凉。

    “陆沉。”她轻声开口。

    陆沉握着茶杯的手一紧。

    “师姐有什么话就直说吧，我可以找王峰师兄……”

    姜怀玉看着他：“找王峰干嘛？你就是那个合欢妖女说的人吧？你还敢找他？”

    “啪！”

    茶杯从手中滑落，碎了一地。
content_en:
On the way back, everyone was still discussing Wang Feng's matter and sympathized with him.

But both Lu Chen and Yu Ning were a little absent-minded.

Similarly, Zhuang Jingbai looked at Lin Tian with a guilty conscience, because Jiang Huaiyu was at least the victim, and she... was the persecutor!

And during those three days, she didn't turn on protection, just in case...

Impossible!She is at the Golden Core Stage, and Lu Chen is at the seventh level of Foundation Establishment. If her stomach can feel turbulent in just three days, then the inheritance of the descendants of the immortal world will be a joke!

In this way, everyone separated with their own concerns, and then went back to their homes.

However, as soon as Lu Chen arrived home, he found a beautiful figure standing in his cave.

Under the moonlight, the woman was wearing a plain white dress and her figure was as graceful as a fairy under the moon.The green silk hair hangs down from the waist, and is only held up loosely by a hosta, giving off a somewhat lazy beauty.

She seemed to hear the movement and turned around slowly.

The moment Lu Chen saw that face clearly, his breathing stopped.

It was a face that was cold and out of the dust, with eyebrows as dark as distant mountains, and eyes like the waves of autumn water.The skin is better than snow, glowing faintly in the moonlight.

But those beautiful eyes were filled with exhaustion and sadness at this moment, and there was a faint redness in the eyes, obviously she had been crying for a long time.

It was Jiang Huaiyu.

She was born extremely beautiful and was recognized as a fairy figure by Xuantian Sect.At this moment, I look a little haggard, and I look even more pitiful, which makes people feel pity for me.

Lu Chen's heart skipped a beat, but he kept his composure on his face and bowed his hands in salute: "Senior Sister Huaiyu? It's so late, why are you..."

"I've been waiting for you for a long time, Lu Chen." Jiang Huaiyu's voice was soft and soft.

Lu Chen's heart skipped a beat and he asked her to take a seat: "Sister, please sit down and I'll pour you some tea."

He turned around to get the teapot, but his hands were shaking slightly.

Jiang Huaiyu did not sit down, but just stood there, his eyes always focused on him.

The gaze was so focused that it sent chills down Lu Chen's back.

"Lu Chen." She said softly.

Lu Chen's hand holding the teacup tightened.

"Sister, if you have anything to say, just say it. I can go to Senior Brother Wang Feng..."

Jiang Huaiyu looked at him: "Why are you looking for Wang Feng? Are you the person that the Hehuan witch talked about? Do you still dare to look for him?"

"Crack!"

The teacup slipped from his hand and shattered on the floor.
